positive_snippets: Recently had a party (~50 personal) in Hotel Ekant in open Garden area. Food quality was good and very Hygiene. Service team has also performed well. Thanks for making our day memorable.
Hotel ekant was peacefull and refreshing ,this located in calm and scenic area surrounded by hills and greenery ,the room were clean,comfortable and neatly maintained,with a warm and homely feel
Good place in faridabad for family dining and parties
negative_snippets:
I had a very bad experience at this restaurant .The staff was rude and not cooperative at all and did not respond properly to our concerns. Their behavior was unprofessional and unhelpful.
The food quality was extremely poor. It seemed old and not fresh, which was very disappointing and unacceptable. Overall, the service did not meet basic expectations.
I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. Definitely not worth the money.
